settings.appearance.title: Appearance

settings.tools.title: Connected tools
settings.tools.intro: Link an AI coding tool to Lific over MCP. Each connection mints a bot identity that acts on your behalf; disconnect any time.
settings.custom.configNote: Use this URL and Authorization header in your client's HTTP MCP settings. The exact config format depends on your client.
settings.custom.invalidId: Use 1-48 letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores for the connection ID, starting with a letter or number.
settings.custom.exists: That connection already exists. Choose a different ID for another agent.
settings.custom.intro: Give each agent or machine its own connection ID. Disconnecting one leaves the others connected.
settings.custom.name: Display name (optional)
settings.account.title: Account
settings.account.intro: Manage your profile, password, and sessions.
settings.password.title: Password
settings.password.tooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.password.note: Changing your password signs you out on every other device and revokes this account's API keys, OAuth sessions and connected tools. You stay signed in here. Every tool you use with Lific has to be reconnected afterwards.
settings.password.changed: Password changed. Connected tools were revoked; reconnect them below.
settings.sessions.title: Sessions
settings.sessions.intro: Sign out of this device, or revoke access everywhere at once.
settings.sessions.signOutAll: Sign out everywhere and revoke access
settings.sessions.confirm: This signs out every device, including this one, and revokes this account's API keys, OAuth sessions and connected tools. Every tool you use with Lific has to be reconnected afterwards. This cannot be undone.
settings.connect.title: Connect {name}
settings.connect.reauth: Connecting {name} gives it lasting access to your account, so confirm your password to continue. You have been signed in for a while.
settings.connect.autoFailed: Signing you in automatically did not work ({reason}), so please confirm your password.
settings.connect.interrupted: That connection was interrupted. Close this and try again.
settings.connect.stillRejected: That still was not accepted. Sign out and sign back in, then try connecting again.
settings.connect.persist.mac: Runs in the current shell. To persist it, add the line to ~/.zshrc (the default macOS shell).
settings.connect.persist.linux: Runs in the current shell. To persist it, add the line to ~/.bashrc or ~/.profile.
settings.connect.persist.windows: setx applies to new terminals, not the current one. Reopen your terminal (or Pi) after running it.
settings.connect.shownOnce: The key is shown only this once, so copy it now. You can reconnect any time to mint a fresh one.

instance.members.footer: Deactivating an account ends its sessions and revokes its API keys and tokens. Nothing it wrote is removed. The last admin who can still sign in cannot be demoted or deactivated.
instance.archived.title: Archived projects
instance.archived.intro: Projects archived from their settings live as one compressed file each on the server. Unarchiving brings one back with its members and history, as a private project.

instance.archived.footer.after: next to the database and are included in backups. Each one is an ordinary project archive, so it can also be imported on another instance.
